title: Backend product route auto-discovery
answers: How do product backend API routes get registered?
How to add a backend endpoint to a product?
How to register webhooks for a product?
body:
- Product defines `products/<name>/backend/routes.py:register_routes(routers)`, e.g. `routers.projects.register(r"x", ViewSet, "project_x", ["team_id"])`.
- Discovery loop: `posthog/api/rest_router.py` (~line 597) `for _routes_module in load_product_modules("routes")` -> `posthog/products.py:load_product_modules` walks INSTALLED_APPS product apps using find_spec.
- `posthog/api/routing.py:RouterRegistry` exposes core parents projects/organizations/environments/root; `add()` rejects callers under `products.`.
- Discovery is eager at ROOT_URLCONF import (not AppConfig.ready), so celery/management commands never load product API.
- Non-router paths: routes.py may define `api_urlpatterns` (api/<product>/) or `webhook_urlpatterns` (webhooks/<product>/), validated/mounted by `posthog/product_urls.py`.
- New product also needs its AppConfig in `posthog/settings/web.py:PRODUCTS_APPS` and a `tach.toml` block; no edit to rest_router.py.
